description: The bar chart illustrates the number of questions, out of 40, where Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generated by GPT-3 using different methods has at least one factual error, categorized by the type of retrieval method used: OneR, NoR, and IRCoT. The vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, ranging from 0 to 40, while the horizontal axis lists the retrieval methods: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MusiQue, and IIRC. The bars are color-coded, with NoR QA in yellow, OneR QA in red, and IRCoT QA in blue. The chart shows that the NoR QA method has the highest number of errors across all retrieval methods, with 29 errors for HotpotQA, 23 for 2WikiMQA, 28 for MusiQue, and 27 for IIRC. The OneR QA method has fewer errors, with 10 for HotpotQA, 14 for 2WikiMQA, 23 for MusiQue, and 11 for IIRC. The IRCoT QA method has the fewest errors, with 5 for HotpotQA, 14 for 2WikiMQA, 23 for MusiQue, and 11 for IIRC. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
